engineeringSkip.reason: This is a buzzword mash-up — it splices real topological-qubit research onto non-existent 'graviton resonators' and spacetime-defect braiding, a coupling with no basis in known physics or any actual research programme.

factCheck.reason: Topological qubits are a real research idea, but gravitons are hypothetical particles that no experiment can produce or detect, let alone couple to a chip — so a 'graviton resonator processor' is a made-up mash-up of two unrelated buzzwords with no basis in known physics.
